subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint: marketplace purchase + reseller orchestration
messages:
From: Matt Liang <matt.liang@acme-health.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + marketplace pathing — can we run weekly checkpoints?

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our procurement and cloud teams reviewed Redwood’s marketplace options and we want to run a short weekly sync to track the MAP items that touch marketplace listing + reseller coordination. Main priorities for us:
- Confirm which SKUs/entitlements need to be in AWS vs. Azure vs. GCP listings
- Understand reseller billing flow (CloudResellers will resell to our accounts)
- Target close: procurement signing + listing live by end of Q3 (we’re working backwards from 2026-09-30)

Can you send a draft MAP and propose a 30-min weekly checkpoint cadence? I can loop in procurement POC Isabel (cc’d).

Cheers,
Matt
Director, Cloud Engineering — Acme Health

[Attachment: vendor_RFI.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Matt Liang <matt.liang@acme-health.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + marketplace pathing — weekly checkpoint invite + MAP draft

Matt — thanks for the clear priorities. I’ve attached a first-pass MAP (MAP_Acme_v1.xlsx) that breaks work into three tracks: Product/onboarding, Marketplace listing, and Procurement/reseller. Proposed weekly cadence: Tuesdays 10:00am PT, 30 minutes — quick status + owners + blockers.

Quick highlights from the draft:
- Marketplace track: initial AWS listing prep (images, AMI/Container manifest, pricing matrix) — owner: Sergio — due 2026-07-22
- Azure listing: alignment on pricing tiers and offer template — owner: Vanessa — due 2026-07-29
- GCP/third-party listing decision: procurement to confirm whether they want GCP official listing or reseller-only on GCP — owner: Matt/Acme procurement — due 2026-07-15
- Reseller billing flow/contract: Isabel/CloudResellers + Redwood commercial — draft SOW and billing flow diagram — owner: Marissa — due 2026-07-16

I’ve also linked a shared checklist (Drive link) and added a HubSpot deal record for visibility.

Next steps: please review the MAP and confirm Tuesday 10am PT works for your team. I’ll send an invite if yes.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_Acme_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 45 KB)]
[Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcDe2FgHIjKLmno]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Matt Liang <matt.liang@acme-health.com>, Isabel Cortez <icortez@cloudresellers.com>
Date: 2026-07-05T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + marketplace pathing — marketplace checklist + reseller handoff notes

Looping in specifics on the marketplace engineering steps so we can be concrete in the MAP:
- AWS Marketplace (container listing): need a signed Commercial Terms + listing manifest (we can reuse Redwood’s base manifest). Engineering needs 2 sample workloads and container verification by 7/19. Owner: Sergio.
- Azure Marketplace (VM offer or Managed Application): requires offer template + publisher ID — Vanessa to start publisher enrollment (takes ~7 business days). Target publisher enrollment start: 7/9.
- GCP: recommend initially using CloudResellers as reseller channel and defer official GCP listing to post-close. If Acme insists on GCP native listing, need 4 weeks for QA and billing integration.

Reseller coordination (Isabel) — please confirm if CloudResellers can:
1) Accept purchase orders and remit to Redwood on a 30-day net basis, and
2) Handle seat-level metering (if Acme wants per-seat billing).

Action items I’ll own in this week’s MAP update:
- Prepare AWS container verification checklist and send to Acme (due 2026-07-12)
- Draft manifest and required assets list (due 2026-07-14)

On the commercial side Marissa — can you confirm whether a resell addendum will suffice or we need a full reseller agreement?

— Sergio
Principal Partner Engineer — Redwood Inference

> On Thu, Jul 2, 2026 at 9:12 AM Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Matt — thanks for the clear priorities. I’ve attached a first-pass MAP...

From: Isabel Cortez <icortez@cloudresellers.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Matt Liang <matt.liang@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-07-06T08:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + marketplace pathing — reseller capacity and billing

Chloe / team — thanks for including CloudResellers. Quick confirmations from our side:
- We can accept POs and remit on Net30 terms, but we’ll need Redwood’s tax & remittance info and a reseller addendum signed before go-live.
- Seat-level metering: we can handle this via our metering adapter; we’ll need a sample tokenization/usage payload from Redwood engineering to validate.
- AWS listing support: we can push for accelerated review once we see the manifest (timeline ~72 hours for our internal QA, then AWS review).

We’ll add a short reseller checklist to the MAP and propose a joint call next week with our billing integration engineer.

Isabel Cortez
Head of Partner Integrations — CloudResellers
[Attachment: CloudResellers_Onboarding_Checklist.docx (docx, 22 KB)]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Matt Liang <matt.liang@acme-health.com>, Isabel Cortez <icortez@cloudresellers.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T17:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + marketplace pathing — agreed owners & next steps (summary)

Thanks everyone — quick summary and owners from today’s MAP checkpoint: 

Meeting notes / decisions:
- Weekly cadence confirmed: Tuesdays 10:00am PT, 30 minutes (starting 2026-07-13).
- GCP listing will be reseller-first for launch; Acme to confirm by 7/15 if they want native GCP listing.
- AWS container verification and manifest: Sergio will deliver checklist by 7/12 and manifest by 7/14.
- Azure publisher enrollment: Vanessa to start enrollment 7/09; target offer draft by 7/29.
- Reseller commercial: Marissa to circulate reseller addendum draft by 7/16; Isabel to validate commercial terms and provide remittance details by 7/15.

Action items (owner — due):
- Sergio — AWS verification checklist (7/12) and manifest (7/14).
- Marissa — Reseller addendum draft + redlines (7/16).
- Vanessa — Azure publisher enrollment start (7/09) and draft offer template (7/29).
- Matt/Acme procurement — confirm GCP approach (reseller vs native) (7/15).
- Chloe — Share updated MAP (v2) after this week’s meeting and create HubSpot tasks (7/09).

Attachments: MAP_Acme_v1.xlsx; Marketplace_Checklist_2026.pdf attached to thread.

If anything is missing or owners need to shift deadlines, flag here and I’ll update the MAP before Tuesday.

— Chloe
Chloe Martin
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
